callbackUrl.description: The public https address of OpenLinker. Shopify sends webhooks to it.
callbackUrl.label: OpenLinker callback URL

location.description: The one location OpenLinker reads and writes stock at. Stock at other locations is not counted.
location.label: Stock location
location.loadFailed: The store's locations could not be read. Enter the location ID instead.
location.unknownWarning: The saved location is not an active location of this store. Stock cannot be read or written until you pick another one.

refunds.description: When you confirm a refund in OpenLinker, Shopify returns the money to the buyer. When off, a confirmed refund is only recorded.
refunds.label: Send refunds to Shopify
refunds.warning: Confirming a refund will move real money on Shopify Payments. Check every amount before you confirm it.

salesCountry.description: The country whose VAT rate is read for products. Leave empty to use the store's billing country.
salesCountry.label: Sales country

unmanagedStock.description: The quantity reported for a variant whose stock Shopify does not track. Leave empty for 1000.
unmanagedStock.label: Quantity for untracked stock
